scenario.title: BATTLE OF MOSCOW - 9 DEC 1941
intro.text:
BATTLE OF MOSCOW - 9 DEC 1941

Dmitrow, North of Moscow

The German offensives against our capital were halted and our strategic counter-offensive started. Your goal is to cross the Moscow-Leningrad railway line and to liberate the city of Klin.

ORDERS
Capture all VH!

NOTES
Attention - winter conditions! If possible, equip your troops with tracked movement. Check if you can switch between wheeled and tracked movement for free.

CORE (recommended)
3x Tank
4x Infantry
1x Anti-Tank
2x Reconnaissance
1x Flak
4x Artillery (+1)
2x Fighter Aircraft
2x Tactical Bomber
header.location: Dmitrov–Klin sector, north of Moscow — 9 December 1941
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-briliant.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.reaction-briliant.text: The Yelnya salient was broken before its defenders could empty it. The first Guards designations are already being discussed; yesterday's fugitives are being offered a new name.
line.reaction-victory.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.reaction-victory.text: Yelnya proved the enemy can be driven back and that our rebuilt formations can survive doing it. Moscow needed both facts.
line.reaction-tactical.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.reaction-tactical.text: The salient is gone, but much of its garrison escaped. We have a victory for the newspapers and a warning for the next headquarters.
line.reaction-lose.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.reaction-lose.text: The Yelnya salient held and the proof Moscow wanted became another casualty list. We now defend the capital without the confidence that operation was meant to purchase.
line.callback-choice-a.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.callback-choice-a.text: At Yelnya you drove through the rupture before the salient emptied. The new crews came out believing audacity had rebuilt the army. They have not yet learned how rare a clean opening is.
line.callback-choice-b.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.callback-choice-b.text: The rotation at Yelnya kept the rebuilt battalions intact. Moscow now asks those same men to pursue in winter; preservation has purchased us a force, not an exemption from risk.
line.scene-0.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.scene-0.text: Fresh ski tracks cross the map table where the paper was carried in from outside. Intelligence reports enemy exhaustion, then lists intact guns at every road junction. Both statements are true.
line.scene-1.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.scene-1.text: At Yelnya the new crews learned that the Germans can retreat. That lesson is useful. Believing every retreat has become a rout would be fatal.
line.decision.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.decision.text: We can pursue across the railway before the retreat becomes orderly, or secure the flanks and bring the guns forward before entering Klin. Winter will punish whichever delay we choose.
line.decision.choice.pursue-across-the-r: Cross the railway in the first bound and keep contact with the withdrawing columns.
Fully refuel the core, give tank and reconnaissance formations 20 experience each, and gain 70 prestige for sustained pursuit.
line.decision.choice.secure-the-flanks.t: Clear the railway approaches and bring artillery forward before the drive on Klin.
line.decision.choice.secure-the-flanks.h: Restore the core to at least eight strength with full ammunition and give artillery 20 experience; fuel remains unchanged.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.choice-a-0.text: Forward detachments carry fuel before comforts. If the enemy stops, we attack from the march before the snow around his guns is packed hard.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.choice-a-1.text: The forward detachments get a fuel return every two hours. Miss one and the following guns halt, however inviting the road looks.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.choice-b-0.text: The railway becomes our supply line, not merely a line crossed on the map. Guns and fuel move first enough that Klin is attacked by an army, not scattered pursuers.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.choice-b-1.text: The Germans are already moving. If our perfect supply line reaches an empty Klin, I want that delay entered under command—not weather.
line.post-0.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.post-0.text: Fuel reports every two hours. If a detachment misses one, the guns stop at the railway, whatever Klin looks like.
